what.text: This page follows refugees from Myanmar living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1310 refugees from Myanmar in the United States, 0.1% of all refugees from Myanmar.
Bangladesh hosts the most refugees from Myanmar, followed by Malaysia, Thailand and India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Myanmar over Karen, Shan and Nagaland territory in periods from 1985, with the KNU active from 2021 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 and 2006.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 13 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 11639, at the end of 2006, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
